auth.adblock_warning_body: Your browser or an extension is blocking ads and popups. Sign-in with Google or Apple may not work — if nothing opens when you click them, disable your ad blocker or use email signup below.
auth.social_trouble_hint: Social sign-in not working? Your ad blocker may be blocking the popup. Use email signup above, or disable the ad blocker and try again.
auth.google_sdk_blocked: Couldn't load Google sign-in. Check your connection or disable your ad blocker, then reload the page.
auth.apple_sdk_unavailable: Apple sign-in isn't available. Check your connection or disable your ad blocker, then reload the page.
auth.apple_popup_blocked: Apple sign-in was blocked by your browser. Disable your ad blocker or popup blocker and try again.
auth.apple_error: Couldn't complete Apple sign-in. Please try again.

plan_details.coupon_available: Use {{code}} at checkout for an extra {{discount}} off

profile.set_password_sub: You signed in with Google or Apple, so your account has no password yet. Choose one to also log in with your email.
profile.err_password_short: New password must be at least 8 characters
profile.err_password_long: New password must be at most 72 characters
profile.err_password_same: New password must be different from the current one
profile.err_generic: Something went wrong — please try again.
profile.personal_info_sub: Update your name. Your email can't be changed.

help.reopen_desc: Use the secure link in your order email to open your eSIM from any device or browser.
help.reopen_fallback: Contact support with your order ID and we'll resend the email.

pickers.search_products: Search a package by name or provider…

products.price_history_sub: See how many units each price point sold, and how much profit it made.
products.price_history_pick_product: Pick a product above to see its price history.
products.price_history_empty: No completed orders for this product in the selected period.
products.price_history_note: Prices are bucketed by the USD price the customer saw at checkout. Older orders without a saved fee or exchange rate have their cost estimated from the current settings. Switch to “Paid price” to see what customers actually paid after discounts.

coupons.show_publicly: Show this coupon to customers on the checkout page
coupons.show_publicly_hint: Customers see the code and can tap it. Leave off for secret codes you share yourself (email, social media).
coupons.vip_only_hint: Only customers whose total spend reached the VIP threshold (Users page) can use it — and see it, if shown publicly.
coupons.form_note: One coupon per order. Limits count orders whose payment did not fail, so failed or abandoned checkouts do not use up a coupon. Fixed amounts are in EGP. Leave packages, countries and providers empty to apply to everything.
coupons.offer_note: Offers apply automatically: customers see the offer badge and the sale price on the plan cards, plan page and checkout, and a coupon can be added on top. Percent offers are limited to 99%.

users.segments_note: VIP: total spend reaches the threshold. New: signed up in the last 30 days. Active: ordered in the last 90 days. Otherwise Inactive. What VIPs get: coupons marked “VIP customers only” (Coupons page) — only VIPs can use and see them.

ops.guest_access_note: If the order-access email failed to reach the customer, reveal the secure link or token here and share it with them, or resend the email.
ops.reveal_confirm: Reveal the guest access link for this order? Share it only with the customer who placed the order.
ops.access_token_note: Share this link or token only with the customer who placed the order.
ops.access_link_unavailable: Frontend URL is not configured (FRONTEND_BASE_URL) — the full access link cannot be built. Provide the access token to the customer directly.
ops.resend_access_confirm: Resend the order access email with the secure link to the customer?
ops.resend_confirm_any: Resend this email to the customer?
ops.admin_alert_email_hint: Receives alerts when the supplier balance drops below the threshold (set in Finance → Settings). Leave empty to fall back to the ADMIN_EMAIL secret, or to disable these alerts if that secret is not set.

referrals.page_help: A referral gives the inviting customer a reward in their wallet (USD balance) after the friend's first order.
referrals.help_referrals: Every friend invited with a referral link. A suspicious one (same person, same network or same card) is held as “Flagged” until you approve or reject it.
referrals.help_ledger: Every movement in customers' wallets: top-ups, purchases paid by wallet, referral rewards, expired or revoked rewards and manual adjustments. Use the form to add or remove balance by hand (a reason is required and logged).
referrals.help_settings: Reward per referral, the minimum first order that earns a reward, the minimum order payable by wallet, and after how many days an unspent reward expires.

package_details.click_hint: Tap a package to see its details.
